records.text: The Variety review read by Owens identified Anthony Summers’ 1985 book Goddess: The Secret Lives of Marilyn Monroe as the basis of the documentary.
records.speaker: Variety

appearances.snippet: I'm sorry, Variety, not Vanity Fair, did a review. And they wrote, quote, we think we're heading we're hearing the beginning of a conspiracy theory, and in a way we are. ... But Anthony Summers, whose 1985 book, Goddess, The Secret Lives of Marilyn Monroe, is the basis of the documentary explicitly states that Monroe (Marilyn Monroe) was not murdered. The result of her tangle of destiny was simply that the Kennedys, who had been tempting fate by carrying on simultaneous affairs with the world's most coveted movie star.
